findings.evidence: `find TauCeti/LinearAlgebra -maxdepth 3 -path '*TotallyReal*' -type f` lists only `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/TotallyReal/Basic.lean` and `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/TotallyReal/Finrank.lean`; grep shows current imports rewritten to `.Basic`/`.Finrank`.
findings.fix: Keep a compatibility shim `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/TotallyReal.lean` that publicly imports `TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.TotallyReal.Basic` and, if intended, `TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.TotallyReal.Finrank`.
findings.issue: The old public import path `TauCeti.LinearAlgebra.TotallyReal` was removed when the file moved to `TotallyReal/Basic.lean`, so downstream code importing the previous module now breaks.

findings.evidence: Line 16 says `a totally real subspace L is one complementary to its J-image`; `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/TotallyReal/Basic.lean:34` defines `IsTotallyReal ... := Disjoint L (L.map J)` and lines 44-45 define `IsMaximalTotallyReal ... := IsCompl L (L.map J)`.
findings.fix: Update the docstring to say `IsTotallyReal` means disjointness and `IsMaximalTotallyReal` means `V = L ⊕ JL`.
findings.issue: The public module doc now says a `totally real subspace` is complementary to its `J`-image, but the PR introduced `IsTotallyReal` as disjointness and reserves complementarity for `IsMaximalTotallyReal`.

summary: The theorem surface is mostly adequate, but the PR breaks an existing public module path and leaves public docs describing the old predicate semantics.
